name: Palindrome
description: Reads the same forwards and backwards.

name: Heavy
description: The sum of its digits exceeds 45.

name: Feather
description: The sum of its digits is less than 15.

name: Grounded
description: The first digit is smaller than the last.

name: Liftoff
description: The first digit is larger than the last.

name: Equilibrium
description: The first and last digits are identical.

name: Turtle
description: All consecutive digits differ by at most 1.

name: Firefly
description: One unique digit among identical others.

name: Echo
description: The first half repeats as the second half.

name: Sandwich
description: First and last digits match, with at least one different digit between them.

name: Bookends
description: The first two digits match the last two.

name: Ascension
description: Every digit is strictly larger than the previous.

name: Decay
description: Every digit is strictly smaller than the previous.

name: Cascade
description: Every digit increases by exactly 1 from the previous.

name: Waterfall
description: Every digit decreases by exactly 1 from the previous.

name: Mountain
description: Digits ascend to a peak and then descend.

name: Valley
description: Digits descend to a trough and then ascend.

name: Mesa
description: Digits rise to a peak, then fall (flat stretches allowed).

name: Canyon
description: Digits fall to a floor, then rise (flat stretches allowed).

name: Hills
description: Digits strictly alternate between rising and falling.

name: Dunes
description: Rises and falls keep alternating (flat stretches allowed).

name: Pocket Mirror
description: Contains a palindrome of 4 or more digits.

name: Rhyme
description: Contains the same 2+ digit substring twice.

name: Alternator
description: Digits strictly alternate between even and odd.

name: Hopscotch
description: A digit appears at every other position (2 times).

name: Double Hop
description: A digit appears at every other position (3 times).

name: Framed Pair
description: A 4-digit number where the middle two digits match each other but differ from both end digits.

name: Framed Triple
description: A triple in the middle, bookended by different digits.

name: Framed Quad
description: Four of a kind in the middle, bookended by different digits.

name: Framed Double
description: Two pairs in the middle, bookended by different digits.

name: Fibonacci Number
description: Part of the golden ratio sequence found in nature.

name: Ouroboros
description: A number raised to itself: nⁿ (1¹, 2², ... 7⁷).

name: Equation
description: Insert one of + − × ÷ and an equals sign to make a true equation.

name: Harshad Number
description: Divisible by the sum of its own digits.

name: Spy Number
description: The sum of its digits equals the product of its digits.

name: Pronic Number
description: The product of two consecutive integers (n * n+1).

name: Pair
description: Contains a pair of matching digits.

name: Contiguous Pair
description: Contains a contiguous pair of matching digits.

name: Two Pair
description: Contains two distinct pairs of matching digits.

name: Three Pair
description: Contains three distinct pairs of matching digits.

name: Full House
description: Contains a set of three and a set of two.

name: Contiguous Full House
description: Contains a contiguous set of three adjacent to a contiguous set of two.

name: Straight
description: Contains a sequence of 5 consecutive digits (ascending or descending).

name: Flush
description: All digits are either all even or all odd.

name: Straight Flush
description: Contains 5 consecutive same-parity digits (02468, 13579, or their reverse).

name: Snake Eyes
description: Contains a single pair of ones and no other pairs.

name: Sequence (3)
description: Contains a sequence of 3 consecutive digits.

name: Sequence (4)
description: Contains a sequence of 4 consecutive digits.

name: Sequence (6)
description: Contains a sequence of 6 consecutive digits.

name: Scramble
description: All digits form a consecutive sequence when sorted.

name: Mini Scramble
description: Contains 3 or more adjacent digits that form a run when sorted.

name: Neighbors
description: Contains two digits that are adjacent in value.

name: Gap One
description: The first and last digits differ by exactly 1.

name: Even Spacing
description: All digits are evenly spaced in an arithmetic sequence.

name: Even Spacing (Absolute)
description: All digits have the same absolute spacing (e.g., ±2 each time).

name: Mirror Bookends
description: First two digits are reversed as the last two.

name: Paired Bookends
description: Starts with a pair and ends with a different pair.

name: Balanced
description: Sum of first half of digits equals sum of second half.

name: Strobogrammatic
description: Looks the same when rotated 180 degrees.

name: Full Day
description: Exactly "86400", the number of seconds in a day.

name: 4 Consecutive Numbers
description: The entire number splits into four consecutive integers in order.

name: 4 Consecutive Numbers (Scrambled)
description: The entire number splits into four consecutive integers, but not in order.

name: 3 Consecutive Numbers
description: The entire number splits into three consecutive integers in order.

name: 3 Consecutive Numbers (Scrambled)
description: The entire number splits into three consecutive integers, but not in order.

name: 2 Consecutive Numbers
description: The entire number splits into two consecutive integers.

name: 2 Consecutive Numbers (Contains)
description: Contains two adjacent substrings that are consecutive integers.

name: 2 Consecutive Numbers (Nearby)
description: Contains two non-adjacent substrings that are consecutive integers.

name: Metronome
description: Splits into three or more numbers with a constant difference.

name: Crescendo
description: Splits into three or more numbers with a constant ratio.
